name: Sticky notes slap on
description: One to four paper sticky notes (yellow, white, orange, mint) with a strip of tape slap onto the picture around the speaker's head one after another, big and tilted, landing with a squash and a thud: a hand-written word or two on each, with an optional emoji; they stay in the top band above the eyes (a fourth goes lower left) and breathe slowly.
use_when: A spoken list of two to four short things (what you get, what's inside, features, examples), said one by one while the face should stay on screen.

notes.help: [{text, emoji, at}] 1-2 words each (<= 14 characters); at = seconds from the scene start (when he says it); emoji optional
